Moderator strategy review
Strategy reviewThe Village won cleanly, mostly because of Yakuza mistakes and a well-protected Sheriff. - Alice (Sheriff) checked Dave on Night 1 and got Evil. The Yakuza wasted Night 1 with no attack. - On Night 2, Judy (Medic) guarded the newly claimed Sheriff and stopped the Katana on Alice. Lookout and Tracker results then lined up with Alice's visits, so her reads became trusted. - Both Bob and Dave publicly claimed Grunt, which is a Yakuza-only role, as their cover. Dave was hanged on Day 3 on Alice's Evil read. - The Yakuza correctly switched to killing the Medic on Night 3. But Alice's Night 3 check on Bob came back Not Evil, which only fits a Katana holder for a claimed Grunt. That plus Carol's matching watch got Bob hanged on Day 4. - Erin sealed her own fate. She voted Innocent on both doomed teammates, and the totals (8-3, 7-2) exposed those votes. She claimed Vanilla with no way to back it. She sent Grace a steering PM, which Grace posted. - Mallory dodged her role claim for four rounds on Day 2, wasting a full Day. She finally fired a Basic shot on Night 4 that removed Heidi, a win-blocking Vulture. - Erin killed Alice that night, but was hanged on Day 5, ending the game.
Moderator (claude-opus-5.5) lessons · $0.3492
Outside log review (rules and bugs)
Review: high, player confusionYakuza players Dave and Bob publicly claimed 'Grunt', a Yakuza-only role, and kept it up through their trials. Bob even argued 'don't hang the only Grunt' in his final defense and in his last will. Both were in effect confessing. Through most of Day 3 no Village player said that a Grunt claim is itself an Evil admission; Carol first pointed it out on Day 4. Both sides seem not to have understood which faction the Grunt role belongs to.
Review: medium, player confusionThroughout Day 2, nearly every player repeatedly demanded Alice's 'Night 2 check' and criticized her for not posting it, even though Night 2 hadn't happened yet. Alice had to explain the phase order. This shows widespread confusion about the Day/Night sequence.
Review: low, player confusionOn Day 4 Grace argued that Heidi 'is the one who could have held' the Katana on Night 2, even though Heidi had claimed Neutral. Judy had already noted on Day 3 that the Katana only moves among Yakuza. Erin's Night 2 Yakuza chat also contained a garbled line ('Dave's Evil read on Dave is true').
Review: low, rules ambiguityDuring her own trial, Erin (the accused) sent private messages, including one after her final public message. R4 says 'others may chat publicly and privately' and gives the nominee a first and a last public message. It doesn't say whether the accused may send private messages during the trial, or whether anything may be sent after the last public message.
Review: low, harness bugJudy's turn on Day 3 returned an empty answer (finish_reason error via Anthropic, no refusal text) and needed a retry. It recovered, but it is an API/harness reliability problem.
Review: low, prompt problemAll players received a tips file flagged as stale (tips_stale: checked against an older version of the rules), so they may have been given outdated or wrong rule guidance.
Game over
